//: Example .explicitrc.json. Drop this file at the root of the project you want ExplicitJS to analyze (it walks up from the analyzed path looking for it, or point at it with --config). These two keys are the whole surface: checks are not configurable - every check is always on, and none can be disabled or suppressed. Per-run choices (--stats-only, --no-color) are command-line flags only. Run 'explicitjs list-checks' for the full catalog.
//format: text | json | csv. Defaults to text. --format always overrides it.
//ignore: Extra directories to skip, on top of the built-in list (node_modules and
dotfile directories at any depth; dist, build, out, coverage, vendor ...
beside a package.json/deno.json or under the analyzed root), which no
config can re-enable. A bare name skips that directory at any depth; an
entry containing a separator is a path relative to THIS file. Directories
only - there are no file patterns and no globs.
